name: email_change_code

metadata.description: Email change verification code sent to the requested new address.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) representing the current account holder.
`new_email` is the new email address and is also the recipient of this message.
The code expires in 10 minutes and is single-use.

html_template:
Confirm your new email address

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A request was made to change your account email address to {{ new_email }}. Use this confirmation code:

Confirmation code
{{ code }}

This code expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request this change, ignore this email and your current address will remain unchanged.

Sent by Django-MOJO
